title: Foreman-C Worker Pool
description: Foreman-C coordinates workers 041-060 as one aggregated pool. The room shows pool summaries plus only important worker exceptions.

messages.text: Workers 041-060 take alternating lanes. The pool pauses dependent rows until Gate A and Gate B are green.

messages.systemLog: Assign work: Foreman-C splits Packet C across alternating lanes with Gate A and Gate B dependencies.

messages.text: worker-052 found a one-block offset in row 02. I am isolating seven placements as a patch and keeping the other lanes moving.

messages.systemLog: Exception report: worker-052 detects a row-02 offset and isolates seven placements for patching.

messages.text: Patch applied to row 02. Gate C is now green; repetitive straight rows can use the bounded place_line helper.

messages.systemLog: Checkpoint update: Foreman-C applies the row-02 patch, clears Gate C, and enables place_line for safe rows.

messages.text: Pool C complete. Workers placed all assigned lanes, skipped high-risk corners for review, and reported zero rollbacks.

messages.systemLog: Receive message: Pool C completes Packet C and submits its diff with high-risk corners marked for review.
